message.content:
{"diagnosis": "Fetch test traps with `TRAP: no progress max_addr=0x00000000` vs expected advancing max_addr/PC and cycles <2009, ending `FAIL 0xdead`. `mem_la_read` at picorv32.v:380 uses `(mem_do_rinst || mem_do_prefetch && mem_do_rdata)` so prefetch-only cycles never assert read. Without `mem_la_read/mem_xfer` the core never completes fetch and stalls at 0x00000000.", "patch_diff": "diff --git a/picorv32.v b/picorv32.v
--- a/picorv32.v
+++ b/picorv32.v
@@ -379,3 +379,3 @@
 	assign mem_la_write = resetn && !mem_state && mem_do_wdata;
-	assign mem_la_read = resetn && ((!mem_la_use_prefetched_high_word && !mem_state && (mem_do_rinst || mem_do_prefetch && mem_do_rdata)) ||
+	assign mem_la_read = resetn && ((!mem_la_use_prefetched_high_word && !mem_state && (mem_do_rinst || mem_do_prefetch || mem_do_rdata)) ||
 			(COMPRESSED_ISA && mem_xfer && (!last_mem_valid ? mem_la_firstword : mem_la_firstword_reg) && !mem_la_secondword && &mem_rdata_latched[1:0]));", "expected": "tohost PASS with progress max_addr>0x00000000 and no no-progress TRAP"}
